legacy_metadata.method: el_classify --threads N --repeat 5 --taxonomy FILE INPUT.ofn, one process per ontology and thread count, run under the benchmark host's lock. classifyMs holds the wall time of each of five classifications by a fresh classifier with the axioms in memory, and peakRssKib the process's peak resident memory including the axioms read.

sources.metadata_note: A manual measurement record of el_classify. Read the record for its method, results and checks.

manifest.build: mbx build --release -p sparkles-owl --example el_classify on stanley
manifest.harness_note: 297 ELK runs used the harness of commit 3b5131ed or 3d8fd876, whose taxonomy output is the same for a consistent ontology. ore_ont_6720, which is inconsistent, ran with 3d8fd876, since the earlier harness stopped on ELK's exception.
manifest.reference: ELK 0.6.0 with OWL API 5.1.20 through scripts/elk-compare (pins in scripts/elk-compare/pins.tsv), Temurin 17.0.20

settings.elk_heap: 16 MiB per MiB of input plus 1 GiB, at most 12 GiB

host.name: stanley
host.role: laptop, loaded by other work, so the times are not measurements

legacy_metadata.method: Each ontology classified once by el_classify --threads 4 --taxonomy and once by scripts/elk-compare/elk.sh run --threads 4 --taxonomy, then scripts/el-oracle.py ELK.ofn OURS.txt. compare.jsonl holds the oracle's report for each ontology, ours.jsonl and elk.jsonl the two tools' JSON lines, elk-incompleteness.json the axiom types ELK reported as possible causes of incompleteness, and taxonomy.sha256 the hashes of both taxonomies.

sources.metadata_note: A manual agreement record of el_classify against ELK 0.6.0 on the ORE 2015 EL sample. Read the record for its method and checks.

context.scale: 36 ORE 2015 EL ontologies with nominals, SameIndividual, ranges with assertions or top-property axioms, and four range test ontologies

manifest.companion: runs/2026-11-02-ore-elk-agreement-aa0a41a6 holds the classifier's and ELK's taxonomies of the same ontologies
manifest.reference: HermiT 1.4.5.519 on OWL API 5.1.20 through scripts/elk-compare/elk.sh run --reasoner hermit (pins in scripts/elk-compare/hermit-pins.tsv), Temurin 17.0.20, the harness of commit 995e8d6f

host.name: stanley
host.role: laptop, loaded by other work, so the times are a rough screen and not measurements

legacy_metadata.method: run.sh.txt ran HermiT once on each input. Its comparison step passed ELK's taxonomy to el-oracle.py in the wrong form, so oracle.sh.txt made the retained comparisons again from the same taxonomies without running HermiT: scripts/el-oracle.py HERMIT.ofn OURS.txt against the classifier, and ref-compare.py.txt HERMIT.ofn ELK.ofn, which reads two reference files with el-oracle's own reader and counts the classes either side names alone. compare.jsonl holds both reports, hermit.jsonl HermiT's JSON lines and cases/ the four test ontologies with each tool's taxonomy. HermiT ran on one thread; the threads field of hermit.jsonl gives the unused --threads default of that harness version.

sources.metadata_note: A manual agreement record of HermiT 1.4.5.519 against the classifier and ELK on the ORE ontologies whose axioms either EL reasoner uses in part, and on four range test ontologies. Read the record for its method and checks.
